{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Thermal base layer: fitted long-sleeve top, hip length, ivory #F1E9E2, fine merino wool
Refined knit: slightly relaxed turtleneck pullover, hip length, soft blue #6F93B5, merino-cashmere blend
Trousers: straight-leg, high waist, full length reaching the top of the boots, charcoal #3E434B, lined wool flannel
Outer coat: single-breasted, mid-calf length, with a wide collar that can be turned up, deep navy #2F3A4F, dense double-faced wool with a removable quilted lining
Boots: flat ankle boots with a deep rubber lug sole, black #1F1F22, waterproof leather with a warm wool lining
Socks: tall thick socks, heather grey #8A8F98, merino wool
Hat: cuffed beanie pulled over the ears, light silver-grey #C9CDD3, wool-cashmere knit
Scarf: oversized, wrapped twice, pale blue-grey #A9B7C9, soft brushed wool
Gloves: classic cuffed gloves, black #2A2A2E, leather lined with cashmere
Bag: structured tote that sits on the shoulder, graphite #3B3F47, water-resistant treated leather

This outfit keeps the neat office look of a knit with tailored trousers while building real warmth for a snowy, deep-frost walk to work. The thermal layer, knit and lined coat trap heat, and the flat, grippy, waterproof boots with a rubber sole handle snow and road salt without any heel. The soft blue knit echoes her eyes, and the navy, charcoal and silver-grey palette flatters her cool, light colouring and silver hair. Everything stays polished enough for the office once the coat, hat and scarf come off."}
